clue.text: Fancy address outside the capital in Norway

indicators.note: outside says the speech word wraps round the letter taken from Norway

parts.note: to address a crowd is to orate, speak formally

indicators.note: the capital letter in a word is its initial, so Norway gives its first letter

explanation.surface: A grand speech being given beyond the Norwegian capital, Oslo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The capital in Norway' tempts you toward Oslo; it is just the capital letter N.
explanation.definitionFit: Fancy as an adjective means elaborately decorated, a synonym of ornate.

parts.note: opera is the plural of opus, a musical work
T. E. Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia, is known by his initials TE

explanation.surface: Putting on plays written by D. H. or T. E. Lawrence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Works' as the plural of opus gives OPERA, not a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate is to function or run, a synonym of perform as a machine performs.

indicators.note: given up says that letter is surrendered, dropped from the word for idea

parts.note: a notion is an idea
one is the Roman numeral I; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a plan they always knew could never work.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, something that is not on is not acceptable or not possible.

clue.text: People in the wrong producing annoyance

indicators.note: in places the word for people within the legal term for a wrong

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
men are people

explanation.surface: People who are at fault cause irritation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The wrong' is the legal sense: a tort is a civil wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe suffering or vexation, a stronger form of annoyance.

indicators.note: in puts the representative's letters inside the house word

parts.note: a pile is a large, imposing house
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative

explanation.surface: An MP is spotted at a grand country house.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot is a small blemish on the skin, the same thing as a zit or pustule.

indicators.note: retaining means the motionless word holds the day's letter within it

parts.note: still means motionless, inert

explanation.surface: Someone still keeps the weekend newspaper's magazine section.
explanation.definitionFit: An insert is a loose extra section placed in a publication, a supplement.

clue.text: Give fake gold to pretentious character

parts.note: to play-act is to put on a fake show, pretend
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Handing counterfeit gold to a show-off.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is the heraldic word for gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A play-actor, literally a stage performer, is figuratively someone who poses or puts on airs.

clue.text: English leader agreed foreign money is a blight

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: yes is said when one has agreed
the ore is a Scandinavian coin, a hundredth of a krona or krone

explanation.surface: An English chief is told that foreign cash is a curse.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyesore is an ugly sight that spoils its surroundings, a blight on the landscape.

definitions.meaning: made out means discerned, picked out by eye

explanation.surface: Someone is portrayed as celebrated.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both discerned with the eyes and eminent or renowned.

indicators.note: caught in says the son's letter is held inside the trap word

parts.note: a net is a trap

explanation.surface: A boy is snared, and someone shouts to fall back.
explanation.definitionFit: A nest is a cosy hideaway or refuge, a retreat.

clue.text: Control put forward and brought back

parts.note: a rein is a means of control
stated means put forward, declared

explanation.surface: Controls are proposed and then reintroduced.
explanation.definitionFit: Reinstated means restored to a former position, returned or brought back.

clue.text: The old man's wife's born a Native American

parts.note: the old man is slang for father, pa
nee is used before a married woman's maiden name, meaning born

explanation.surface: Father's wife turns out to be of Native American birth.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after man and wife is a link, standing for has and is.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pawnee are a Plains people of Nebraska and Kansas, so a member is a Native American.

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
or introduces the alternative

explanation.surface: A boxer chooses between studying or something else.
explanation.definitionFit: A toreador is a bullfighter, especially one on horseback.

parts.note: re means about, concerning
pent means shut up, confined
a worker ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: Someone humbled after hearing about an imprisoned labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone chastened is subdued and sorry for their wrongs, which is contrite.

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange and unusual, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Smitten by someone's foreign manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To be enamoured of someone is to be infatuated with or in love with them.

parts.note: a sty is the home of pigs, beasts

explanation.surface: A nobleman finds an ugly sight in the pigpen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A 7' points to the answer at 7 down, EYESORE: a swollen eyelid is literally a sore on the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, a punning instance of a sore eye.

clue.text: Directed to accept a title tole

definitions.note: a misprint for title role, the main part in a play

indicators.note: to accept says the guided word takes the letter inside it

parts.note: led means directed, guided

explanation.surface: A director told to accept a starring part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tole' is a misprint for 'role': the lead is the title role.
explanation.definitionFit: The lead is the principal part in a play or film, as a title role usually is.

indicators.note: conceals means the king's name hides the next word within it

parts.note: King Lear, Shakespeare's tragic king

explanation.surface: A monarch keeps something secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb pairing with 'conceals'; it is the noun, an animal skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A hide is an animal's skin, which tanned becomes this material.

clue.text: I stay true, prepared for great self-denial

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, worked into new shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vow of honesty made in readiness for a life of abstinence.
explanation.definitionFit: Austerity is severe self-discipline and abstinence from comforts, great self-denial.

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician exclaims in dismay at a damaged instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The theorbo is a large bass lute of the seventeenth century, a stringed instrument.

clue.text: Attempt to incorporate one book in a cycle

indicators.note: to incorporate says the attempt word takes the following letters inside it

parts.note: a try is an attempt
one is the Roman numeral I
a log is a book of records

explanation.surface: Trying to fit one more book into a series.
explanation.definitionFit: A trilogy is a set of three related works, a cycle of novels or plays.

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the next word

parts.note: to shore up is to stay, prop or support

explanation.surface: Frogs at first remain out of the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stay' means prop up, as a ship's stay supports a mast, not remain.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashore means on the land rather than at sea.

clue.text: Charlie wakes up and makes merry

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO alphabet
arouses means wakes up

explanation.surface: Charlie gets out of bed and starts to party.
explanation.definitionFit: To carouse is to drink and celebrate noisily, to make merry.

clue.text: The way tripe's cooked shows pizzazz

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or tampered with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chef's style of cooking offal shows flair.
explanation.definitionFit: Esprit is liveliness and wit, the same sparkle as pizzazz.

definitions.meaning: a pea, bean or lentil is a legume eaten as food
a heart-throb is literally a beat of the heart

explanation.surface: Someone's idol is called a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heart-throb' wants to mean a pin-up; it is taken literally, as a heartbeat.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an edible legume seed and the throb of blood in the arteries.

clue.text: An uproar during applause for old Roman sportsman

indicators.note: during puts the uproar inside the applause word

parts.note: a cheer is applause
an gives the article A
a riot is an uproar

explanation.surface: A commotion breaks out amid ovations for an ancient athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: A charioteer drove a racing chariot in the Roman circus, a sporting contest.

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the crowd word

parts.note: a lot is a group, a crowd
Oscar is O in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone named Rob spots Oscar among the throng.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rob' looks like a man's name; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To loot is to plunder or steal from, to rob.

parts.note: to rid is to free, clear
a den is a study, a private room for work

explanation.surface: Someone made a trip to obtain a study at no cost.
explanation.definitionFit: Ridden is the past participle of ride, so it means travelled on horse or bike.

parts.note: the leader of cheer, its first letter
the OM, Order of Merit, is a British honour or distinction
Ely is a cathedral city and bishop's see in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: An attractive cheerleader wins an award and shouts about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheerleader' splits as the leader of cheer; 'See!' is a bishop's see, ELY, a cathedral city in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Comely is an old-fashioned word for attractive or good-looking.
